title: WaterColor 143 Dandelion Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in WaterColor's Cottage District- Conveniently located near community pools, tennis courts, dining, shopping, and the beach- Gas grill- High-speed wireless internet- Fully-equipped gourmet kitchen- 4 adult bikes provided - 2 dedicated parking spots with additional parking throughout community- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout.Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Leave your cares behind and escape to this stunning and tranquil WaterColor home! Nestled in the peaceful Cottage District, 143 Dandelion Drive is an idyllic home offering a fantastic location, 3 luxurious bedrooms, 3 beautiful bathrooms, and wonderful accommodations for 10 guests.A sprawling front porch full of Adirondack chairs welcomes you for a wonderful getaway. Inside, an open floorplan connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas. Granite countertops, top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinet space make the gourmet kitchen a home cook's dream. A spacious breakfast bar and the large dining area nearby offer plenty of seats for guest dining. Plush furnishings, a large flat-screen television, and ample windows create a bright and airy place to relax. Also on this level is a spacious primary bedroom boasting beautiful wainscoting details, a lavish king bed, and a private bathroom with a shower, a spa tub, and a dual-sink granite vanity. The second bedroom on this level offers another plush king bed, a mounted flat-screen television, and a private bathroom with a shower.The second level showcases a variety of sleeping accommodations, sure to please everyone in your group. The guest room features 2 full beds and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The second-floor living room boasts a mounted flat-screen television and a plush queen sleeper sofa, and kids will love the tucked-away twin bunk bed area.Start your day with a cup of coffee and soak in the peaceful surroundings as you relax on the screened back porch. The lush landscape encircles the back yard area, where guests can enjoy an alfresco meal in beautiful surroundings. This home is conveniently located near the community tennis courts and the stunning and newly renovated Camp WaterColor, which offers a perfect place to splash in the pools and float along the lazy river. Hop on one of the 4 custom 360 Blue adult beach cruiser bikes for a breezy ride to the sugar-white sand beach and sparkling emerald waters. Explore the best coastal dining, shopping, and entertainment along scenic Highway 30A and experience the slice of heaven that is our local culture. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom- Guest Bedroom: King BedSECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: 2 Full Beds- Bonus Bunk Area: One Set of Twin Bunk Beds- Sitting Area: Queen Sleeper SofaWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please Note: Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home, and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
